config.purpose: WP04.0 diagnostic probe only; this config never drives the formal 20-epoch four-arm training
config.disclosure: diagnostic-only probe on D410-S1 train seeds 1-20; no dev/confirm seed, no data collection, no game launch, no formal model

sample_selection.label_rule: tier A = exactly one verified candidate, alive, chosen==discounted top1, discounted margin >= raw_gap_min, undiscounted margin >= geo_gap_min; tier B = the same with undiscounted margin 0 (the preference is the 5.0 discount). unknown candidates are never negatives: the target is the single verified action.

duplicate_conflicts.note: identical (play, hud, act_hist) bytes with different targets; such samples bound the achievable train accuracy below 100 %

small_fit.loss: cross-entropy on the single verified action (KL with a one-hot target)

sensitivity.not_claimed: input sensitivity is a probe of the fitted probe network on 12 paired states; it is not an evaluation of control capability, robustness or closed-loop performance

cpu_cross_check.note: the same weights forwarded on CPU: distinguishes a device kernel-order effect from a model/code effect

determinism.note: repeat = the same tensor forwarded twice; batch = row 0 forwarded alone vs inside a batch; reorder = the same batch in reverse order. cudnn benchmark is off by default, so a non-zero batch difference is kernel/algorithm selection and is reported, not hidden.

cross_kl.note: every entry is a finite KL because the second argument is the full-support raw softmax; KL(raw || one-hot) is infinite by construction and is reported as -log p_target under 'discount_decomposition'

discount_decomposition.note: KL(raw||uniform) = log(18) - H(raw). 'kl_created_by_discount' is the same quantity minus the undiscounted target's KL, i.e. the divergence the -5.0 discount itself creates; the verified/unverified parts are the exact signed split of KL(raw||uniform) by candidate group (a negative part means that group carries less than its uniform share).

label_signal.note: raw_geo_score already carries the teacher's -5.0 discount on every 'unknown' candidate; 'undiscounted' adds it back. The discount decomposition splits KL(raw||uniform) exactly into the verified and unverified candidate groups, so the report states how much of the target's divergence the discount owns at each tau instead of assuming it. 'grad_l1_share_on_unverified' is ~0.5 for any peaked target (the deficit on the verified candidate equals the total excess on the other 17), so the L2 gradient norm is the discriminating gradient number.

not_claimed: no control-capability claim: nothing here runs the game or measures survival in a closed loop
no formal four-arm 20-epoch training: the probe network is a 0.4-0.8 M diagnostic model, not the P3 target architecture
no dev/confirm seed was read (train seeds 1-20 only)
the small-fit accuracy measures memorisation of 256 fixed samples, not generalisation
sensitivity numbers describe one fitted probe network on 12 paired states, not the sensitivity of the target architecture
